text:
Rohit: Quick microcopy check  We show a share link expiration tooltip when users copy a session share link. Current tooltip: 'Link expires soon' — feels unhelpful.
Maya: Agree. Not specific on timeframe or action. Users want to know what to do.
Claire: What's the exact UI? It's a small tooltip with copy button and an expiry countdown in minutes.
Rohit: Yep. We can show either a short inline tooltip or a longer helper on hover. Need concise text that works for SR.
Maya: For short tooltip: 'Share link expires in 2 hours' — replace minutes dynamically. Avoid absolute words like 'soon'.
A11yTeam: For SRs, include a brief prefix so it reads as a notification: e.g., sr-only 'Link expiry:' then the visible text. Also make sure the tooltip is keyboard accessible and the countdown updates don't spam the live region. Use aria-live="polite" and only announce when crossing thresholds (like under 10 minutes).
Claire: Action advice could be helpful on hover: 'Share link expires in 2 hours. Generate a new link to extend access.' But keep tooltip short and put the action in the expanded helper or popover.
Rohit: Proposed copy variants:
- Tooltip (short): 'Link expires in {duration}.'
- Helper (hover/popover): 'This share link will expire in {duration}. Generate a new link to extend access or toggle persistent link in settings.'
Maya: Microcopy nit: 'Generate a new link' vs 'Create a new link'  we use 'Create' elsewhere for links. Keep consistent: use 'Create a new link'.
A11yTeam: Also recommend thresholds for SR announcements: when duration <= 10 minutes, prefix with 'Urgent: ' in the live region only, not visually. E.g., sr-only 'Urgent: link expires in 9 minutes.'
Claire: UX question: do we include exact seconds in the countdown? Probably not; minutes are fine.
Rohit: Final: tooltip token: 'link.expiry.short' = 'Link expires in {n}.' helper token: 'link.expiry.detail' = 'This share link will expire in {n}. Create a new link to extend access or enable persistent links in settings.' SR rules: include sr-only 'Link expiry:' prefix always; when n < 10 minutes, include sr-only 'Urgent:' prefix. aria-live=polite, only announce threshold crossings.
DesignBot: Checklist: avoid vague words, show duration, separate short tooltip vs detailed helper, sr-only prefixes, polite live region, threshold announcements under 10 minutes, localized duration formatting.
Maya: Looks good. Please add acceptance criteria: tooltip localizes duration, helper includes link to settings, SR announcements only on thresholds, and copy matches 'Create a new link' wording.
Rohit: I'll update figma and add copy tokens + a11y notes in the ticket. Thanks! :thumbsup:
